sql: SELECT match_id, start_time, duration, game_mode, lobby_type, avg_rank_tier, radiant_team, dire_team, radiant_win FROM public_matches WHERE game_mode = 22 AND lobby_type = 7 AND match_id >= 8744109859 AND avg_rank_tier BETWEEN 70 AND 89 AND ((radiant_team @> ARRAY[44]::int[] AND radiant_win) OR (dire_team @> ARRAY[44]::int[] AND NOT radiant_win)) ORDER BY match_id DESC LIMIT 4
